sentences.text: Vessel Master produces the Crew Count Correction when a verified headcount differs from the departure record.
Crew accountability covers personnel movement between shore facilities, vessels, offshore structures, and the return journey.
Personnel Tracking Console maintains the current accountability status for personnel assigned to offshore work.
Personnel confirm their identity before entering controlled shore access areas.
North Access Scanner records identity checks at the north shore access point.
South Access Scanner records identity checks at the south shore access point.
Duty Planner verifies that planned crew assignments match the approved work schedule before mobilization.
Marine Coordinator reviews the intended crew movement against vessel capacity and operating conditions.
Vessel Master confirms the departure roster before the vessel leaves port.
The departure headcount is reconciled against the crew manifest before the vessel gets underway.
Marine Coordinator monitors reported vessel movements during transit to offshore locations.
Vessel AIS Receiver provides vessel position information for movement monitoring.
Personnel report any change in destination or transfer plan to the Vessel Master as soon as practicable.
The Vessel Master records crew changes that occur during transit or between offshore locations.
Personnel are accounted for before a transfer from a vessel to an offshore structure begins.
Field Supervisor confirms the work party is complete before personnel enter the work area.
Personnel report their arrival and departure at each active work location using the approved site process.
Work access is limited to personnel whose assignment and authorization are current.
HSE Officer verifies that personnel expected at the work site are accounted for during scheduled checks.
The Vessel Master maintains an onboard count while personnel are aboard the vessel.
Marine Coordinator reviews return movements so that shore personnel can anticipate vessel arrivals.
Personnel are reconciled against the return roster when they disembark at shore.
Field Supervisor escalates any unexplained absence or overdue check-in to Marine Coordinator without delay.
When communications are unavailable, the responsible supervisor keeps a local record and reports it when service is restored.
Accountability records retain the time, location, responsible role, and disposition of each material movement.
